2607.13394.title: GFlowRL: Scaling Distribution-Matching RL to Large Language Models
2607.13394.paper_summary: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) offer a promising alternative to reward-maximizing reinforcement learning (RL) for large reasoning models, encouraging diverse reasoning paths by matching reward distributions rather than collapsing to dominant modes. Recent work shows promise on math and code, but scaling GFlowNet-style RL to modern post-training pipelines remains difficult: as model size, rollout horizon, reward noise, and distributed-systems complexity grow together, a learned prompt-conditional partition function becomes a source of gradient instability and engineering overhead rather than a useful normalizer. Through systematic analysis, we find that the learned partition function, previously treated as essential, can be replaced by an in-batch Monte Carlo estimate computed from the rollout group already required for training. We propose GFlowRL, a streamlined GFlowNet-style RL algorithm that removes the auxiliary partition network entirely while preserving the reward-distribution-matching objective, completed by two stabilizers: importance-sampling correction for rollout/trainer drift and asymmetric flow-gap clipping for outlier residuals. GFlowRL exceeds all counterparts on math, code, and adversarial red-teaming benchmarks, reaching a Codeforces rating of 2048 at the 14B scale (within 25 Elo of o3-mini) and attaining the highest average ASR@1 on AdvBench and HarmBench, outperforming the previous SOTA multi-turn attacker in a regime where FlowRL, a prior GFlowNet-style method, diverges. The same recipe transfers to all evaluated MoE configurations up to 235B parameters, where FlowRL again fails to converge. To our knowledge, GFlowRL is the first GFlowNet-style RL algorithm to scale stably across both dense and sparse architectures. Code will be at: https://github.com/microsoft/gflowrl
2607.13394.paper_summary_zh: 生成流網絡（GFlowNets）為大型推理模型提供了一種有前景的替代方案，與獎勵最大化的強化學習（RL）相比，通過匹配獎勵分佈來鼓勵多樣化的推理路徑，而不是簡化為主導模式。最近的研究在數學和代碼方面顯示出潛力，但將GFlowNet風格的RL擴展到現代後訓練管道仍然困難：隨著模型大小、展開範圍、獎勵噪聲和分佈式系統複雜性一起增長，學習的提示條件分區函數成為梯度不穩定和工程開銷的來源，而不是有用的正規化器。通過系統分析，我們發現，先前被視為必需的學習分區函數，可以被從已經要求的展開組中計算的批內蒙特卡羅估計所替代。我們提出了GFlowRL，一種精簡的GFlowNet風格RL算法，完全去除了輔助分區網絡，同時保留了獎勵分佈匹配的目標，並由兩個穩定器完成：針對展開/訓練者漂移的重點抽樣修正和針對異常殘差的非對稱流差剪裁。GFlowRL在數學、代碼和對抗性紅隊基準測試中超越了所有對手，在14B規模下達到2048的Codeforces評分（在o3-mini的25 Elo範圍內），並在AdvBench和HarmBench上達到最高的平均ASR@1，表現超過了先前的SOTA多輪攻擊者，在FlowRL，一種先前的GFlowNet風格方法發散的情況下。相同的配方可以轉移到所有評估的MoE配置，最多235B參數，其中FlowRL再次無法收斂。據我們所知，GFlowRL是第一個在密集和稀疏架構中穩定擴展的GFlowNet風格RL算法。代碼將在：https://github.com/microsoft/gflowrl
